title: Give OLY-2-07 the critic role as its mechanism, with a test
summary: Ares's adversarial challenge is met by the existing critic role (prompts/critic.md). The change extends the critic prompt to name counterexamples, fragile assumptions, failure modes and regressions, adds a test that fails without those, and records the mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml.

defaults_applied.how: Test criterion plus cargo test, clippy, fmt.
Test checks prompt content that changes the critic's behavior, and fails without it.
One prompt edit, one test, one spec entry.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-context/prompts/critic.md (existing critic role, 955 of 1300 tokens used), crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS has no adversarial label, so the measure uses `status: not shown`), and the existing OLY-2-05/06 entries in docs/spec.toml. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are not touched. The property is measured directly on the composed prompt text.
Existing code: crates/athena-context/prompts/critic.md, crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs, docs/spec.toml; none is created by the job.
Goal: the spec auditor (Hestia) and maintainers can see a real mechanism for Ares; the existing critic role is the adversarial reviewer, so no new role is built.
Consumers: none found for config; no athena.toml or defaults.toml change.
The critic prompt change stays under the 345-token headroom; the critic set is composed only of contract and frame.critic.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml OLY-2-07 has mechanism naming crates/athena-context/prompts/critic.md (the critic role), owner Ares, and a measure ending with `status: not shown` that names the test showing it; the mechanism is no longer "none".
crates/athena-context/prompts/critic.md instructs the critic to search for counterexamples, fragile assumptions, failure modes and regressions (Grep for each term).

A new test in crates/athena-context asserts the composed critic prompt contains those four adversarial duties; run `cargo test -p athena-context`. It fails when the prompt text is reverted and passes with it.
The critic prompt set stays within its token budget and the xtask spec test still passes; run `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`, all clean.

out_of_scope: Adding a new Ares role or pipeline stage
Changing athena.toml, defaults.toml or other requirements in docs/spec.toml
Adding a new athena status line
